methods.label: Add the fractions, then take the reciprocal
methods.explanation:
First evaluate the quantity inside the parentheses using a common denominator:
\[
\frac12+\frac15+\frac1{10}
=\frac5{10}+\frac2{10}+\frac1{10}
=\frac45.
\]
An exponent of \(-1\) means the reciprocal of a nonzero number. Since \(\frac45\ne0\), the expression equals
\[
10\left(\frac45\right)^{-1}
=10\cdot\frac54
=\boxed{\frac{25}{2}},
\]
which is choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
